behavior: The kit shows custom loading and motion components: spinner, dot loader, shimmer skeleton, indeterminate progress bar and a success check that draws itself
acceptance: Given /kit, then an Animations section shows Spinner, DotLoader, Shimmer, ProgressBar (indeterminate) and SuccessCheck from ui-web, each with an accessible label and token colors, and all stop moving under reduced motion
notes: 2026-10-08 review fail by subagent: Shimmer sweep never crosses the block. packages/ui-web/src/components/motion.tsx:57 puts after:-translate-x-full on the ::after; in Tailwind 4.3.3 that sets the separate CSS 'translate' property (-100%), which adds to the keyframe 'transform' from packages/design-tokens/src/base.css:159-163 (fw-shimmer: to translateX(100%)). Net movement is -100% -> 0%, not -100% -> +100%. Browser evidence (localhost:3000/kit, sampled every 110ms): ::after translate stays '-100%' while transform goes 106 -> 255px (block width 256px) and then resets to 0. So the 70% surface-colored band slows down until it covers the whole block, then snaps away each 1.44s loop. Fix: drop after:-translate-x-full and give fw-shimmer 'from { transform: translateX(-100%) }' (same as fw-progress). Everything else passes: tokens only (--fw-line, --fw-accent, bg-accent, bg-surface-2, text-success, --fw-surface); roles and labels are correct (Spinner and DotLoader role=status, ProgressBar role=progressbar with no value because it is indeterminate, SuccessCheck role=img, Shimmer aria-hidden). With reducedMotion=reduce: 0 running animations; SuccessCheck circle and tick stroke-dashoffset are 0px (fully drawn); ProgressBar segment rests at x=0, 154px wide, visible; Shimmer blocks keep the surface-2 fill. Play again remounts the check. Screenshot: apps/web/.impeccable/review/f019-animations.png (light | dark). Checks: ui-web test 15/15 passed, playwright 17/17 passed, biome lint clean, typecheck passed.

2026-10-08 review pass by subagent: Re-review after the Shimmer fix. motion.tsx:57 no longer sets after:-translate-x-full; base.css fw-shimmer goes from translateX(-100%) to translateX(100%). Browser check on localhost:3000/kit, ::after sampled every 110ms on a 256px block: translate=none, transform x = -206, -157, -74, 40, 135, 187, 223, 243, 253, then resets to -256, so the band now crosses the full block. Reduced motion (reducedMotion=reduce, light and dark): 0 running animations; SuccessCheck circle and tick stroke-dashoffset 0px (fully drawn, and with animation-delay now 0ms the tick does not lag); ProgressBar segment rests at x=0, 154px wide; Shimmer blocks keep their surface-2 fill (rgb(234,242,240) light, rgb(26,37,33) dark). Minor, not blocking: under reduced motion the shimmer band rests centered over each block (transform none), which shows as a soft lighter middle in light mode; the blocks still read as placeholders. Tokens only; roles and labels still correct (status x2, progressbar, img; Shimmer aria-hidden). Screenshot retaken: apps/web/.impeccable/review/f019-animations.png (light | dark, reduced motion). Checks: pnpm --filter @forwend/ui-web test 15/15 passed; playwright e2e/a11y.spec.ts 4/4 passed (axe on / and /kit, both themes). Earlier full playwright run 17/17, lint and typecheck passed.
